translations.web: In the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was severe in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.
translations.bsb: By the ninth day of the fourth month, the famine in the city was so severe that the people of the land had no food.
translations.kjv: And in the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was sore in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.
translations.asv: In the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was sore in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.
